a.lede: There’s a reason frontier labs have gotten gunshy about consumer AI — and it’s not because the tech isn’t good enough.
a.title: The ugly economics of consumer AI

b.lede: The price of AI "intelligence," has fallen dramatically in recent years, faster than any other transformational technology in history according to some estimates. This raises serious questions about the need to retain access to frontier capabilities, when they show up elsewhere so swiftly.
b.title: The price of AI is crashing faster than the rate of Moore's Law, report suggests
